items.html: *And a reason must be given why two things were needed: first, the restriction; second, the placing of the Parsa. But the matter is that the lower ones can receive the light only through the diminution of the light, and also by its coming through screens. Now, since in the world of Nekudim was the main beginning of the revelation of the vessels, the aforementioned restriction was needed, so that the light would be diminished and the vessels of the Nekudim would be able to bear it. And also, being restricted there, they are greatly pressed, and through this they come out (17) forcefully through the Einayim and expand downward.
